prompt:
Reference image: the attached picture is the first picture of this series, a gouache painting of a harbour. Use it only as a sample of the painting: match its paper texture, brush handling, flat opaque colour shapes, edges, palette, light and level of detail exactly, as if painted by the same hand on the same day. Do not copy its composition, its layout or its objects: this is a new picture of a different place, described below. There is no harbour, no quay and no boat in this picture.

Hand-painted illustration from a classic children's picture book, painted with opaque gouache on warm off-white watercolour paper. Matte, chalky, fully opaque paint laid down in flat colour shapes with visible brush marks; dry-brush edges where the paper grain shows through; lighter colours painted on top of darker ones; fine flecks of paper texture everywhere. Simple, rounded, friendly shapes for young children: soft round cloud shapes, plump, slightly leaning buildings and furniture, soft wobbly walls, round smooth rocks, naive, slightly flattened perspective. Few large objects and very little small detail: stones, planks and floorboards only hinted with a few loose rounded dabs, no fine rigging, no fine wood grain, no tiny flowers. Warm limited palette of mixed gouache colours: apricot, peach and coral glow along the horizon, warm dusty teal and deep warm blue in the upper sky and the sea, ochre, terracotta, sage green and cream on buildings, walls, wood and stone; the darkest colour is a warm deep blue-violet, never black. Soft, calm dusk light with gentle contrast. No black outlines. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not smooth digital airbrush, not a detailed postcard, not transparent watercolour, not an oil painting.

Composition for a fixed side-view adventure game screen. The picture will be cropped to a wide 16:9 format: the top 8% and the bottom 8% are cut off, so keep everything important inside the middle band. Series rules, identical for every picture of this series: Time of day: dusk, shortly after sunset; outdoors and in the windows the sky is warm dusty teal and deep warm blue with a band of apricot, peach and coral light at the horizon and the first small stars. Light: soft, calm dusk light with gentle contrast; lamps, windows and fires are small warm spots of light. Camera: straight-on view at standing eye height, vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon (indoors: the horizon seen through the windows) at about 46% of the picture height. The floor or ground where characters walk runs as one continuous, level band across the whole width of the picture, from about 70% of the picture height down to the bottom edge; this broad strip is free and walkable from left to right, furniture and objects stand at its back edge or at the far left and right, the middle stays free. The upper middle of the picture, between 25% and 72% of the width and down to about 33% of the picture height, is a calm, almost empty area of flat colour (outdoors the sky with only a few small stars, indoors a plain stretch of wall or ceiling): the story text of the page will be placed there.

Location: the lamp room at the top of the white lighthouse of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk, seen from inside. A small round room with whitewashed, slightly curved walls and a low wooden ceiling. Left of the centre, set back from the open floor, stands the big brass lighthouse lamp inside a tall lens of stacked glass rings, glowing softly and warmly. On the far left a small wooden desk with an open logbook, an oil can and a brass telescope. On the right an iron spiral staircase leads down through a round opening in the floor. Two tall windows in the back wall show the darkening calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon and the first stars. A coil of rope and a wooden crate stand against the wall. Worn wooden floorboards.

Do not paint effects that the game animates: the big lamp glows softly inside its lens, but without any light beams, rays, glare, sparkles or halo around it; no birds outside the windows; no dust in the air. These effects are animated separately in the game.

Leave the floor and the path free of people and animals: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
ref_note: Take only the painting technique, the paper and the palette from it, not its composition or objects.
